$comment: S10 adsb.lol live aircraft (T060). Measure columns added to the common envelope (common.json). Field map: configs/sources/s10.yaml; rules: decision D108.

fields.name: aircraft_id
fields.meaning: hex, the transponder address as given (non-ICAO addresses keep their prefix)

fields.name: position_at
fields.meaning: now (milliseconds) minus seen_pos (seconds); lastPosition is used when lat/lon are absent

fields.name: lat
fields.meaning: degrees; rows without a supplied position are not written

fields.name: altitude_m
fields.meaning: alt_baro feet x 0.3048; null when not reported or on the ground (see on_ground)

fields.name: speed_ms
fields.meaning: gs knots x 1852/3600; null when not reported

fields.name: on_ground
fields.meaning: true when alt_baro is the string ground

fields.name: position_type
fields.meaning: upstream type, for example adsb_icao or mlat (how the position was obtained)

valid_at: position_at; the map hides a position 300 s after it
dropped: Positions older than 300 s at fetch, aircraft without a position, and aircraft flagged LADD or PIA in dbFlags. Callsign, registration and type designator are never stored
